title: R Shiny Apps
text:
These apps run on your machine



Every R package listed here includes a Shiny app. The apps run locally in R — install the package from CRAN and launch from your console. There is no hosted version: the service that previously hosted these apps is no longer under my control, so rather than ship links that fail, each card below gives you the exact command.

title: R Shiny Apps
text:
Regression and modeling




olsrr
Build linear regression models and iterate through specifications quickly. Produces full olsrr model output from the UI.
install.packages("olsrr")
olsrr::ols_launch_app()







blorr
Build, validate and monitor binary logistic regression models with comprehensive output, model fit and validation statistics.
install.packages("blorr")
blorr::blr_launch_app()







xplorerr
One app, seven entry points. Linear and logistic regression, descriptive statistics, inference, RFM analysis, distributions and the visualizer.
install.packages("xplorerr")
xplorerr::app_linear_regression()
Also available: app_descriptive(), app_visualizer(), app_logistic_regression(), app_inference(), app_rfm_analysis(), app_vistributions().

title: R Shiny Apps
text:
Statistics




descriptr
Generate and visualize descriptive statistics for numeric and categorical data. Explore key statistical distributions with interactive plots.
install.packages("descriptr")
descriptr::ds_launch_shiny_app()







inferr
Beginner-friendly hypothesis testing with parametric and non-parametric tests, flexible input options and structured results.
install.packages("inferr")
inferr::ifr_launch_shiny_app()







vistributions
Visualize probability distributions and run statistical quality checks on univariate data.
install.packages("vistributions")
vistributions::vdist_launch_app()

title: R Shiny Apps
text:
Customer analytics




rfm
Customer segmentation using recency, frequency and monetary value analysis. Build customized segments from customer- or transaction-level data.
install.packages("rfm")
rfm::rfm_launch_app()









nse2r has no app



nse2r exported an nse_app() Shiny entry point, but the package was archived on CRAN on 2023-08-07 and is under revival, so it is deliberately excluded from this page rather than shipped with a command that cannot be run. See Packages for its current status.

title: Aravind Hebbali
text:
I build statistical software that holds up outside a tutorial, and I help teams do the same. My work sits where R, statistics, economics and finance overlap — regression diagnostics, customer segmentation, descriptive and inferential statistics, and the unglamorous plumbing that keeps analysis reproducible.
I am the author of the open-source package portfolio below and six data science textbooks, and the founder of Rsquared Academy, an open-source education platform.
I earned my postgraduate degree from Madras School of Economics (Anna University), Chennai, and now work independently from Bengaluru, India. The packages are maintained on my own time and see far more use than I expected.

title: R Packages
text:
Regression and modelling




olsrr
Tools for building OLS regression models. Coefficient diagnostics, ANOVA tables, influential observation analysis and model comparison.
Reference · CRAN · GitHub







blorr
Tools for developing binary logistic regression models, with comprehensive regression output, model fit statistics and validation measures.
Reference · CRAN · GitHub







xplorerr
Interactive data exploration and visualization: correlation heatmaps, scatterplots, distribution checks and regression modelling from a point-and-click interface.
Reference · CRAN · GitHub

title: R Packages
text:
Descriptive and inferential statistics




descriptr
Descriptive statistics and frequency tables for numeric and categorical data. Skewness, kurtosis and key statistics, computed fast.
Reference · CRAN · GitHub







inferr
Hypothesis testing and inference. Parametric and non-parametric tests with structured, readable output: t-test, chi-square, ANOVA and correlation.
Reference · CRAN · GitHub







vistributions
Visualize probability distributions of univariate data across continuous and discrete families, with statistical quality checks.
Reference · CRAN · GitHub

Archived






nse2r — archived, under revival



nse2r fetched live data from the National Stock Exchange of India. It was archived on CRAN on 2023-08-07 at the maintainer’s request and is currently being revived, so it is no longer installable from CRAN.
Source and issue tracker: github.com/rsquaredacademy/nse2r.

title: E-Books
text:
About these books
They began as blog posts, expanded into tutorials on Rsquared Academy, then collected and rewritten into these short books. The writing style is deliberately plain — short chapters, worked examples, and the parts of the documentation people usually skip.
None of them replaces the official R documentation. If you want one place to start, Introduction to R is the one.
If these were useful, the courses behind them are at rsquaredacademy.com.
